# Project Phoenix v45.0 — 12-Era AI Strategic Calibration (Main Mod, 1337-1836, AI-only, additive, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v450_ai_and_audio_calibration.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Additive Day-1 & yearly AI calibration pulses (0 vanilla overrides, R10/R31/R44 clean).
on_game_started_after_lobby = {
	on_actions = {
		oe_v45_ai_calibration_start_pulse
	}
}

yearly_country_pulse = {
	on_actions = {
		oe_v45_ai_calibration_yearly_pulse
	}
}

oe_v45_ai_calibration_start_pulse = {
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1337
				current_year <= 1836
			}
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_ai = yes
					is_rebel_country = no
					NOT = { country_type = pop }
					NOT = { country_type = building }
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_is_elysia }
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_is_nova_elysia }
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_voyager }
				}
				oe_v45_ai_apply_era_calibration = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

oe_v45_ai_calibration_yearly_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { country_type = pop }
		NOT = { country_type = building }
		current_year >= 1337
		current_year <= 1836
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_ai = no }
			oe_v45_ai_clear_stale_modifiers = yes
		}
		else = {
			oe_v45_ai_apply_era_calibration = yes
		}
	}
}
